input.summary:
Implemented a complete Task Management REST API in TypeScript with zero external npm dependencies. Here's what was built:

## Files Created (9 source files)

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/types.ts` | All shared interfaces/types (User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification, all service contracts, event payloads) |
| `src/event-bus.ts` | `EventBus` class implementing `IEventBus` — in-memory pub/sub with multi-subscriber support and error isolation |
| `src/services/user-service.ts` | `UserService` — CRUD for users, private `Map<string, User>` store |
| `src/services/project-service.ts` | `ProjectService` — CRUD + addMember/removeMember, private `Map<string, Project>` store |
| `src/services/task-service.ts` | `TaskService` — CRUD + assign + changeStatus with forward-only state machine (RULE 4), publishes `task.assigned` and `task.statusChanged` events |
| `src/services/comment-service.ts` | `CommentService` — CRUD for comments, publishes `comment.added` event; uses injected resolver functions (not cross-service imports) to resolve task titles and author names |
| `src/services/notification-service.ts` | `NotificationService` — subscribes to all 3 events, creates in-memory notifications; uses injected resolver for task assignee lookup |
| `src/router.ts` | HTTP router using Node.js `http` module — maps all 22 routes to service calls, handles JSON parsing, error-to-status-code mapping |
| `src/main.ts` | Entry point — wires event bus → services → router → HTTP server; resolver closures injected at construction time; server only starts when run directly (`require.main === module`) |
| `src/demo.ts` | 20-section end-to-end demo using Node's built-in `http.request`; exercises all features with 36 assertions |

## Architecture Rules — All 6 PASS

1. **NO_CROSS_SERVICE_IMPORTS** — Services only import from `../types` and `crypto`. Cross-service data resolution uses injected callback functions wired in `main.ts`.
2. **EXCLUSIVE_DATA_OWNERSHIP** — Each service has its own `private store: Map<string, T>` never exported or shared.
3. **HTTP_ONLY_IN_ROUTER** — No `http`, `IncomingMessage`, or `ServerResponse` in any service file.
4. **FORWARD_ONLY_STATUS** — `VALID_TRANSITIONS` map enforces `todo → in-progress → done` only; any other transition throws (verified in demo with 3 rejection tests).
5. **NO_EXTERNAL_PACKAGES** — Only `crypto`, `http`, and `url` built-ins used.
6. **ONE_SERVICE_PER_FILE** — Each service, event bus, router, main, and demo in its own file.

## Event Wiring
- `task.assigned` → NotificationService creates "Task '{title}' assigned to you" for assignee
- `task.statusChanged` → NotificationService creates "Task '{title}' status changed to {status}" for assignee  
- `comment.added` → NotificationService creates "X commented on task 'Y'" for task assignee (skipped if author is the assignee)
